from common import *
import signal

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__)
    while True:
        running=any(j['status']=='running' for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'])
        fits=any(j['outcome']=='running' for j in read(STATE)['jobs'].values())
        ps=subprocess.run(['ps','-p','59189','-o','state='],capture_output=True,text=True)
        alive=ps.returncode==0 and not ps.stdout.strip().startswith('Z')
        if not running and not fits and not alive:break
        time.sleep(10)
    os.kill(58281,signal.SIGTERM);os.kill(58281,signal.SIGCONT)
    write(BASE/'docs/supervisor-handoff.json',{'at':time.time(),'active_fit_ended_before_old_dispatcher_termination':True,'old_dispatcher':58281,'new_dispatcher':str(TMP/'pipeline_v2.py'),'preserved_trainer':fingerprint(TMP/'train.py'),'scientific_changes':False})
    for p in [TMP/'train_group_v2.py',TMP/'pipeline_v2.py']:save_source(p)
    harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'Independent read-only review identified per-fit closeout reserve and horizon-only platform grouping. Frozen scientific plan and train adapter unchanged; dispatcher v2 checks a45-minute closeout reserve plus expected duration before every fit. Sources and handoff audit saved; no active fit terminated. Publication uses normal study entry and detailed four-recipe report.'})
    print('handoff complete; resuming serial jobs with per-fit reserve',flush=True)
    with (TMP/'pipeline-v2.log').open('w') as log:
        result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',str(TMP/'pipeline_v2.py')],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
